distractors.text_hint: the charity bake sale on Friday
signed off the inspection on the 11kV board on Tuesday

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Friday, first of May. Aisha Begum's absent today, so it's just us. Can everyone hear?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, bit tinny, but you're there.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Morning. The heating in the portakabin's apparently decided it's December.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: You've still got your fleece on.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: It's practically welded to me. Just an observation, before anyone gives me a thermostat to fix.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: We can hear the fan more than we can hear you.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Better now? Moved the microphone.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Much better, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And the charity bake sale on Friday — today, obviously. I've been thinking it's Thursday all morning.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That's a dangerous mistake on a Friday.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Depends whether there's any cake left by the time stores get there.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Not with this lot.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a cake allocation meeting. Updates first. Marcus?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'm here. Teams was hiding the unmute button from me.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: The purchase order chase — my deadline's moved. It's now by the 28th.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, got that.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And, um, the other one isn't such good news.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I can't get the training records for the new starters sorted because the parts haven't turned up. That's what's holding me up.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Ah, right.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Bit frustrating, to be honest.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah. Thanks. Controls next?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep, just finding my bit of paper. Very advanced system here.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I've greased and checked the bearings on the long belt. All done, no issues found.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Nice when it's boring.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Boring's absolutely fine with me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, anything to pass on before we get into today's stuff?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, passing this on for boss: the run to Kestrel for the replacement parts is done. All picked up.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Am I next, or—

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Go on. Sorry, talked over you.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: No, you're all right.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Booking a contractor to look at line two — I'm about halfway through that. Made some headway, but I haven't got the booking nailed down yet.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the 11kV board on Tuesday. That's already finished.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks. Doyler?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: The downtime for the Engel is all scheduled with production. That's sorted, no issues found with the arrangement.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That sounded remarkably painless.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Don't sound so surprised.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, today's new bits, then.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I'll update the risk assessment for work on the Arburg. Normal priority, and I'll have it done by the 28th.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Doyler. Agreed on that.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, okay.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I've got one as well. Um— sorry, thought someone else was speaking.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I'll write up the near miss at line 2 for next Tuesday. That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed. Olumide Adeyemi on the write-up, then.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, your audio clipped at the end there.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Just said yep, that's mine. This microphone's having a morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Olumide Adeyemi, can you do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the guard switch on two for Monday as well? Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: No, sorry, I can't take that on for Monday. I haven't got the capacity to commit to it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, Jamie, can you take the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the guard switch on two instead? Monday, and drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take that. Lock-out tag-out sign-off on the guard switch on two, Monday. That gets first call.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Jamie.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Glad you said no rather than just squeezing another thing in.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah. Tempting to say yes when everyone's looking at you, isn't it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Half of us are looking at our own frozen faces, to be fair.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that's the lot. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers, all.
